observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor and indoor stages and courtyards, night and evening performances
observation.dancers: mixed groups of men and women, including soloists and large ensembles of men
observation.formation_and_space: circles of seated men, pairs, and groups moving across a stage
observation.posture: deep low stances with bent knees, upright torso, or dynamic martial poses
observation.footwork: stamping, shifting weight in low squatting steps, and quick articulated foot placements
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive hand gestures with hyper-extended fingers, arms held at shoulder or chest height, holding fans or props
observation.hips_and_torso: isolated upper body shifts, deep side-to-side torso sways, and controlled hip alignment
observation.partnering: solo dancing, character interactions, and coordinated ensemble lifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low floor crouching, leaps, elevated group lifts, and spins
observation.costume_and_props: elaborate gilded crowns, ornate patterned sarongs, face paint, masks, fabric sashes, and lit torches
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer and fast footwork details due to wide camera angles and rapid cuts

signature_moments.what: Dancers in traditional attire performing low crouching movements while holding flaming torches
A large circle of bare-chested men chanting and raising their arms rapidly in unison
Ensemble members lifting a central performer overhead while keeping hands raised
